delta_metrics.gate4_basis: Accepted because EV improved by more than 10% in all three fixed non-overlapping windows, total return improved in all three windows, trade count and win rate were unchanged, and drawdown increases stayed well below the 1 percentage point Gate 4 cap.

hypothesis: After Technology and Commodity trend target-width repairs, the next unblocked alpha may be capital allocation rather than another exit-width permutation. If the accepted A+B stack is under-allocating to tight-stop winners because the 20% single-position cap binds before the risk budget is deployed, raising only `MAX_POSITION_PCT` to a conservative 25% should improve EV across fixed windows without changing entries, exits, ranking, LLM, C strategy, or existing cohort sizing rules.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage; this run deliberately used deterministic capital-allocation alpha instead of LLM ranking.
